summary: Fix compatibility between Ray Data's write_lance / LanceDatasink and PyLance by inspecting lance.write_dataset parameters or package version before passing storage_options_provider.
assumptions: The lance.write_dataset function signature is available for inspection.
The installed PyLance version is known.
The lance module version is known or can be easily determined.

changes.purpose: Modify lance.write_dataset invocation to include storage_options_provider conditionally.
changes.after: if supported: lance.write_dataset(**kwargs, storage_options_provider=True) else lance.write_dataset(**kwargs)

changes.description: Add unit test to verify dataset writes succeed with and without storage_options_provider.
changes.code:
def test_lance_write_dataset_with_provider(self):
  # Test setup and data preparation
  dataset = write_lance(...)  # With storage_options_provider
  assert dataset.success

def test_lance_write_dataset_without_provider(self):
  # Test setup and data preparation
  dataset = write_lance(...)  # Without storage_options_provider
  assert dataset.success

tests.description: Test lance.write_dataset behavior when storage_options_provider is not accepted.
tests.code:
def test_lance_write_dataset_without_provider(self):
  # Test setup and data preparation
  dataset = write_lance(...)  # Without storage_options_provider
  assert dataset.success

verificationSteps: Inspect lance.write_dataset function signature and verify PyLance version support for storage_options_provider.
Run updated unit tests in python/ray/data/tests/test_lance.py to ensure compatibility and functionality.
warnings: Watch for different versioning schemes or signature changes in PyLance across minor releases.
